settings.title: Settings
settings.restoreMessage: All game settings will return to their original values.

controls.description: Click a binding and press a key or a controller button to change it. Escape cancels.

display.description: Tune the way the world is presented on your screen.
display.fullscreenDescription: Play the chronicle using the whole screen.
display.imageRenderingPixelatedDescription: Nearest-neighbour scaling: keeps the pixel art crisp and blocky.
display.imageRenderingSmoothDescription: Blends neighbouring pixels when scaling, softening the pixel art.
display.imageRenderingCrispDescription: Edge-preserving scaling: sharp lines without blurring the colours.
display.scaleDescription: Renders the world at a smaller size and then enlarges it to fit the screen. Lower values enlarge the components and reduce the number of rendered pixels.
